"SBLGNT:Luke.8.13": ["A", [28], "S103-INC-MTF-013", "Luke 8:13 rootless hearers fall away in the time of testing; context cited with 8:15."],
"SBLGNT:Luke.8.14": ["R", [28], "", "Luke 8:14 choked by cares and riches; context only, no holding/endurance wording."],
"SBLGNT:Luke.8.15": ["A", [28], "S103-INC-MTF-013", "Luke 8:15 hold fast (κατέχουσιν) and bear fruit in endurance; ṣabr as holding."],
"SBLGNT:Mark.8.35": ["R", [1], "", "Mark 8:35 saving/losing life is context for 8:36, whose gain/loss wording was quoted; no separate block."],
"SBLGNT:Mark.8.36": ["A", [1], "S103-INC-MTF-001", "Mark 8:36 gain the whole world and forfeit (ζημιωθῆναι) one's soul; loss/gain vocabulary beside the exception paragraph."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.10.22": ["R", [1], "", "Matt 10:22 the one who endures to the end will be saved; same point as Luke 21:19 which was quoted."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.11.28": ["R", [24], "", "Matt 11:28 rest for the burdened; burden relief by Jesus, not the capacity limit of 6:152; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.11.30": ["R", [24], "", "Matt 11:30 easy yoke, light burden; resembles 'no soul beyond capacity' but Exod 18:18-22 shows the burden measure inside a community."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.16.27": ["R", [27], "", "Matt 16:27 repaid according to deeds; same as Rom 2:6 which was chosen."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.18.15": ["R", [26], "", "Matt 18:15 reprove a brother to gain him; correction procedure; 2 Tim 2:24-25 used for paragraph 26."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.18.16": ["R", [26], "", "Matt 18:16 witnesses accompany correction; procedural, no addition."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.20.12": ["A", [11], "S103-INC-MTF-004", "Matt 20:12 full-day workers protest equal pay; the difference in measure noted in the annotation."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.20.13": ["A", [11], "S103-INC-MTF-004", "Matt 20:13 the agreed denarius; part of the wage dispute summarized."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.20.15": ["A", [11], "S103-INC-MTF-004", "Matt 20:15 the owner's generosity; the wage is measured by goodness, summarized in the annotation."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.20.8": ["A", [11], "S103-INC-MTF-004", "Matt 20:8 when evening came the workers are called and paid; the evening wage scene quoted."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.24.12": ["R", [21], "", "Matt 24:12 love grows cold through lawlessness; no counterpart to transmitting error (51:53)."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.24.13": ["R", [1], "", "Matt 24:13 endurance to the end brings salvation; duplicates Luke 21:19."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.25.35": ["R", [21], "", "Matt 25:35 feeding the hungry; resembles 90:14 but the page's paragraph is about mutual counsel of mercy; Zech 7:9 used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.25.40": ["R", [21], "", "Matt 25:40 deeds for the least counted as for the king; not about mutual counsel."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.5.16": ["R", [12], "", "Matt 5:16 good works seen by others; display of works, not their loss; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.5.44": ["R", [38], "", "Matt 5:44 love enemies; close to 41:34 but Rom 12:20-21 (reading Prov 25:21) was used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.6.12": ["R", [23], "", "Matt 6:12 forgive our debts as we forgive our debtors; debt metaphor of sin; Rom 13:8 fits mutual obligation better."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.6.20": ["A", [14], "S103-INC-MTF-005", "Matt 6:20 treasure where neither moth nor rust consume; the time-erosion contrast of paragraph 14."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.6.4": ["R", [11], "", "Matt 6:4 reward for hidden alms; not a wage-for-work scene."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.7.21": ["R", [12], "", "Matt 7:21 not everyone saying 'Lord' enters; word/deed contrast, not loss of works; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.7.24": ["R", [10], "", "Matt 7:24 hearing and doing builds on rock; the building image could match the well-lining of paragraph 10 but is a hearing/doing parable; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.7.25": ["R", [10], "", "Matt 7:25 the house on rock withstands storm; context of 7:24; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Matt.7.26": ["R", [12], "", "Matt 7:26 hearing without doing builds on sand; collapse image, but the page's loss paragraph is better served by 1 Cor 3:15."],
"SBLGNT:Phil.4.9": ["R", [18], "", "Phil 4:9 practise what you learned and received from me; transmission, but 2 Tim 2:2 shows the chain explicitly."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.12.11": ["R", [30], "", "Rev 12:11 not loving life unto death; martyr motif beside 7:126 but no restraint/vessel image."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.14.12": ["R", [2], "", "Rev 14:12 endurance of those keeping commands and faith; faith-endurance pair; no added point."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.2.10": ["R", [30], "", "Rev 2:10 be faithful unto death; martyr faithfulness; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.2.19": ["R", [2], "", "Rev 2:19 works, love, faith, service, endurance; another list; no added point."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.2.2": ["R", [2], "", "Rev 2:2 works, labour and endurance; list without reciprocal verbs; no addition."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.2.3": ["R", [28], "", "Rev 2:3 endurance and not growing weary; no restraint wording."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.2.4": ["R", [2], "", "Rev 2:4 abandoned first love; contrast within a letter; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.20.12": ["R", [27], "", "Rev 20:12 dead judged by deeds written in books; duplicates Rom 2:6 for paragraph 27."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.22.12": ["R", [27], "", "Rev 22:12 wage with me to give each according to work; duplicates Rom 2:6."],
"SBLGNT:Rev.3.19": ["R", [26], "", "Rev 3:19 those I love I reprove; divine reproof, not mutual counsel."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.12.12": ["A", [38], "S103-INC-YGL-005", "Rom 12:12 enduring in affliction, cited in the reading of Prov 25:21 as the patience in the same chapter."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.12.20": ["A", [38], "S103-INC-YGL-005", "Rom 12:20 quotes Prov 25:21-22 on feeding an enemy; the Christian reading of the Proverbs text."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.12.21": ["A", [38], "S103-INC-YGL-005", "Rom 12:21 overcome evil with good; quoted beside 41:34."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.13.8": ["A", [23], "S103-INC-MTF-009", "Rom 13:8 owe nothing except to love one another; mutual debt contrasted with ḥaqq as due."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.15.1": ["R", [32], "", "Rom 15:1 the strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak; close to the kefil image but one-directional; Gal 6:2 used."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.2.5": ["R", [27], "", "Rom 2:5 storing up wrath for the day; context of 2:6-7 only."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.2.6": ["A", [27], "S103-INC-MTF-012", "Rom 2:6 render to each according to works; quoted for the day of ḥāqqa."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.2.7": ["A", [27], "S103-INC-MTF-012", "Rom 2:7 to those who by endurance in good work seek glory, eternal life; joins patience and good work."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.2.8": ["R", [27], "", "Rom 2:8 wrath for those disobeying the truth; context of 2:6-7; no separate addition."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.4.4": ["A", [6], "S103-INC-YGL-002", "Rom 4:4 the worker's wage reckoned as debt not grace; part of Paul's reading of Gen 15:6 quoted."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.4.5": ["A", [6], "S103-INC-YGL-002", "Rom 4:5 faith of the one who does not work reckoned as righteousness; the Pauline side of the Gen 15:6 debate."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.5.3": ["R", [28], "", "Rom 5:3 affliction produces endurance; causal chain, not restraint; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.5.4": ["R", [28], "", "Rom 5:4 endurance produces character and hope; not used."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.5.5": ["R", [30], "", "Rom 5:5 love poured into hearts; pouring image resembles 7:126 'pour patience on us' but the object is love, not patience; noted, not used."],
"SBLGNT:Rom.8.25": ["R", [29], "", "Rom 8:25 waiting with endurance for the unseen; waiting motif, Lam 3:26 preferred for the silence/restraint link."],
"SBLGNT:Titus.2.2": ["R", [2], "", "Titus 2:2 sound in faith, love, endurance; virtue list for elders; no added point."],
"Bava Metzia 30b": ["R", [26], "", "Bava Metzia 30b (opened as SEFARIA:Bava_Metzia.30b) reads Exod 18:20 'which they shall do' as going beyond the line of the law and blames Jerusalem's fall on insisting on strict law; a rich text, but it concerns legal strictness versus equity, not mutual counsel of ḥaqq; not used.", ["SEFARIA:Bava_Metzia.30b"]],
"Makkot 24a": ["A", [1], "S103-TEV-MTF-002", "Makkot 24a (SEFARIA:Makkot.24a) reduces the 613 commandments to lists of eleven, six, three, two and finally Habakkuk's one, 'the righteous shall live by his faith'; a rabbinic short catalogue of the saving life."],
"Mishnah Avot 1:1": ["A", [18], "S103-TEV-MTF-009", "Avot 1:1 (SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.1) chain of receiving and handing on the Torah; matches the word joined to its successor."],
"Mishnah Avot 1:12": ["R", [13], "", "Avot 1:12 Hillel: love peace and pursue peace; peace-making is touched in paragraph 13, but Peah 1:1 (making peace as a lasting deed) was used.", ["SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.12"]],
"Mishnah Avot 1:14": ["R", [2], "", "Avot 1:14 'if I am only for myself, what am I'; a self/other maxim, but Taanit 23a's 'companionship or death' states the solitary-versus-community contrast more sharply.", ["SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.14"]],
"Mishnah Avot 1:17": ["R", [10], "", "Avot 1:17 'not study but deed is the main thing'; deed over word, but paragraph 10 concerns the intentional trace of work; not used.", ["SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.17"]],
"Mishnah Avot 1:2": ["R", [2], "", "Avot 1:2 the world stands on Torah, service and deeds of kindness; a triad, no reciprocal verbs; not used.", ["SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.2"]],
"Mishnah Avot 1:6": ["R", [19], "", "Avot 1:6 make a teacher, acquire a companion, judge favourably; companionship in learning, but Avot 3:2 ties it to the reciprocal verb of Mal 3:16.", ["SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.6"]],
"Mishnah Avot 2:15": ["A", [11], "S103-TEV-MTF-006", "Avot 2:15 (SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.2.15) the day is short, the work much, the wage great; the work-day image beside the evening wage."],
"Mishnah Avot 2:16": ["A", [11], "S103-TEV-MTF-006", "Avot 2:16 (SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.2.16) 'faithful (ne'eman) is your employer to pay your wage'; wage secured with the root of trust."],
"Mishnah Avot 3:2": ["A", [19], "S103-TEV-YGL-002", "Avot 3:2 (SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.3.2) reads Mal 3:16: two who share words of Torah have the Shekhinah among them; rabbinic reading of the reciprocal verb."],
"Mishnah Avot 4:16": ["R", [14], "", "Avot 4:16 this world as a vestibule to the world to come; preparation motif, not lasting works; weak.", ["SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.4.16"]],
"Mishnah Avot 4:2": ["A", [3], "S103-TEV-MTF-004", "Avot 4:2 (SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.4.2) one commandment draws another and the wage of a commandment is a commandment; set beside the ayah's replacing the wage with further acts."],
"Mishnah Avot 5:17": ["A", [26], "S103-TEV-MTF-015", "Avot 5:17 (SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.5.17) a dispute for the sake of Heaven endures; a contrary nuance to the ayah's preference of counsel over contention."],
"Mishnah Peah 1:1": ["A", [14], "S103-TEV-MTF-008", "Peah 1:1 (SEFARIA:Mishnah_Peah.1.1) deeds whose fruits are eaten in this world while the principal remains; capital image for lasting works."],
"Rosh Hashanah 29a": ["A", [7], "S103-TEV-YGL-001", "Rosh Hashanah 29a (SEFARIA:Rosh_Hashanah.29a) Mishnah asks whether Moses' hands made war and turns the steady hands into Israel's inward orientation; reading of Exod 17:11-12."],
"Shabbat 127a": ["R", [14], "", "Shabbat 127a (SEFARIA:Shabbat.127a) repeats the Mishnah Peah 1:1 list (fruits eaten, principal remains) and a six-item variant; duplicate of the Peah annotation, not quoted separately.", ["SEFARIA:Shabbat.127a"]],
"Shabbat 31a": ["R", [2], "", "Shabbat 31a (SEFARIA:Shabbat.31a) Hillel's 'what is hateful to you do not do to your fellow' is a generic reciprocity rule; the page uses instead Rava's judgement question on dealing in emunah from the same folio (see the research verdict).", ["SEFARIA:Shabbat.31a"]],
"Sirach 2:2": ["R", [28], "S103-TEV-KNT-001", "Ben Sira 2:2 (SEFARIA:Ben_Sira.2.2) appears only in bracketed Hebrew (a reconstruction, not a manuscript witness); recorded in the source note, not used as Hebrew evidence."],
"Sirach 2:4": ["R", [28], "S103-TEV-KNT-001", "Ben Sira 2:4 (SEFARIA:Ben_Sira.2.4) bracketed Hebrew 'in your breaking be long of spirit' with a mismatching English line; reconstructed text, recorded in the source note."],
"Sirach 2:6": ["R", [28], "S103-TEV-KNT-001", "Ben Sira 2:6 (SEFARIA:Ben_Sira.2.6) bracketed Hebrew 'trust him and he will hold you'; reconstructed text, recorded in the source note."],
"Sirach 4:28": ["R", [26], "", "Ben Sira 4:28 in this Hebrew witness reads 'do not sit with an unjust judge'; it does not say what the reader proposed (strive for truth unto death, a Greek-text reading); rejected on textual grounds.", ["SEFARIA:Ben_Sira.4.28"]],
"Sirach 6:14": ["R", [7], "", "Ben Sira 6:14 'a faithful friend (אוהב אמונה) is a strong friend'; relevant to the trustworthy person of paragraph 7, but Exod 17:12 gives the physical sense of emunah that the paragraph's camel image needs.", ["SEFARIA:Ben_Sira.6.14"]],
"Sirach 6:16": ["R", [31], "", "Ben Sira 6:16 'a bundle of life is a faithful friend' (Greek: medicine of life); the medicine wording is the Greek's, not the Hebrew shown; not used.", ["SEFARIA:Ben_Sira.6.16"]],
"Ta'anit 23a": ["R", [20], "", "Taanit 23a (SEFARIA:Taanit.23a) Honi and the carob planted for grandchildren is a general intergenerational motif, not a transmitted word; the same folio's 'companionship or death' saying was used for paragraph 2 (see research verdict).", ["SEFARIA:Taanit.23a"]],
"Wisdom of Solomon 2:19": ["R", [28], "", "Wisdom 2:19 in Sefaria is a later Hebrew translation of a Greek work (SEFARIA:The_Wisdom_of_Solomon.2.19); testing the righteous one's forbearance is not evidence for Hebrew patience vocabulary.", ["SEFARIA:The_Wisdom_of_Solomon.2.19"]],
"Wisdom of Solomon 3:5": ["R", [28], "S103-TEV-KNT-001", "Wisdom 3:5 (SEFARIA:The_Wisdom_of_Solomon.3.5) Hebrew is a translation of the Greek; recorded in the source note, not used as Hebrew evidence."],
"Wisdom of Solomon 3:6": ["R", [28], "S103-TEV-KNT-001", "Wisdom 3:6 (SEFARIA:The_Wisdom_of_Solomon.3.6) gold tried in the furnace; Hebrew is a translation of the Greek; recorded in the source note."],
"Wisdom of Solomon 3:9": ["R", [7], "", "Wisdom 3:9 (SEFARIA:The_Wisdom_of_Solomon.3.9) 'the faithful (אמונים) shall abide with him' is a translated Hebrew, so the אמנ wording is the translator's; not used.", ["SEFARIA:The_Wisdom_of_Solomon.3.9"]],
"WLC:1Kgs.18.45": ["R", [17], "", "1 Kgs 18:45 clouds and heavy rain end the drought; rain image without the joining-of-pasture motif; not used."],
"WLC:1Kgs.8.35": ["A", [29], "S103-TEV-SYD-010", "1 Kgs 8:35 בְּהֵעָצֵר שָׁמַיִם 'when the heavens are shut up'; עצר as restraint, cited in the root-range annotation."],
"WLC:1Sam.17.47": ["R", [25], "", "1 Sam 17:47 the battle is the LORD's, not by sword; no penetrating-thrust image; not used."],
"WLC:1Sam.17.49": ["R", [25], "", "1 Sam 17:49 David's stone sinks into Goliath's forehead; a striking image near 21:18 'smashes its brain', but the link is visual only and adds no root or text evidence; not used."],
"WLC:2Chr.20.20": ["R", [4], "", "2 Chr 20:20 הַאֲמִינוּ ... וְתֵאָמֵנוּ ... וְהַצְלִיחוּ repeats Isa 7:9's wordplay (and adds צלח); Isa 7:9 was quoted as the earlier and better-known instance."],
"WLC:Amos.8.5": ["R", [23], "", "Amos 8:5 shrinking the ephah and falsifying scales; market fraud fits the husr-as-short-weight note, but Dan 5:27 carries the cognate root directly."],
"WLC:Dan.5.27": ["A", [23], "S103-TEV-SYD-009", "Dan 5:27 Aramaic חַסִּיר 'found wanting' in the scales; cognate of خسر by sound correspondence, quoted."],
"WLC:Dan.6.4": ["R", [7], "", "Dan 6:4 (MT) says Daniel excelled by an excellent spirit; the Aramaic מְהֵימַן is in MT 6:5, not 6:4 (English 6:4); rejected as a verse-numbering error. 6:5 was opened and judged separately."],
"WLC:Deut.15.10": ["R", [23], "", "Deut 15:10 give without a grudging heart; generosity law, not mutual right; not used."],
"WLC:Deut.15.8": ["R", [23], "", "Deut 15:8 lend sufficient for his need (מַחְסֹרוֹ); חסר appears as 'need', but the verse is a loan law adding nothing to Dan 5:27's weighing sense."],
"WLC:Deut.19.15": ["R", [26], "", "Deut 19:15 two or three witnesses establish a matter; legal procedure, not reciprocal counsel."],
"WLC:Deut.2.7": ["R", [1], "", "Deut 2:7 'you have lacked nothing (לֹא חָסַרְתָּ)' in the wilderness; חסר as lack, but the verse adds nothing specific to the exception paragraph."],
"WLC:Deut.24.15": ["A", [11], "S103-TEV-MTF-005", "Deut 24:15 pay his wage on his day before the sun sets; the evening wage as an owed due."],
"WLC:Deut.30.14": ["R", [18], "", "Deut 30:14 the word near, in mouth and heart, to do it; word+deed, but not transmission between generations; not used."],
"WLC:Deut.31.12": ["R", [18], "", "Deut 31:12 assemble all to hear and learn; public reading, close to transmission but Avot 1:1 shows the chain explicitly."],
"WLC:Deut.31.13": ["R", [18], "", "Deut 31:13 children who did not know shall hear and learn; context of 31:12; not used."],
"WLC:Deut.32.47": ["R", [18], "", "Deut 32:47 'it is not an empty word for you, it is your life'; resonant with the binding word but no reciprocal or intergenerational verb; not used."],
"WLC:Deut.4.8": ["R", [23], "", "Deut 4:8 righteous statutes (חֻקִּים); חקק here in the statute sense only; the due/portion sense used in paragraph 23 is better shown by Lev 10:13."],
"WLC:Deut.6.7": ["R", [18], "", "Deut 6:7 teach them diligently to your children; transmission to children, but Gen 18:19 (paragraph 20) already carries the father-to-children charge."],
"WLC:Eccl.1.3": ["A", [10], "S103-TEV-SYD-006", "Eccl 1:3 what profit in all his עָמָל; עמל as wearying toil, quoted for the semantic shift."],
"WLC:Eccl.11.6": ["R", [11], "", "Eccl 11:6 sow in the morning and do not rest your hand in the evening; work until evening, but no wage; not used."],
"WLC:Eccl.12.14": ["R", [27], "", "Eccl 12:14 God brings every deed into judgment; same as Rom 2:6 which also joins endurance in good work; not quoted."],
"WLC:Eccl.2.11": ["A", [10], "S103-TEV-SYD-006", "Eccl 2:11 all the toil I toiled is vanity, no profit; עמל range cited."],
"WLC:Eccl.2.22": ["A", [10], "S103-TEV-SYD-006", "Eccl 2:22 what has a man of all his toil (עֲמָלוֹ); same semantic range, cited in the annotation's sources."],
"WLC:Eccl.3.7": ["R", [28], "", "Eccl 3:7 a time to keep silent and a time to speak; silence as timing, not restraint of lament."],
"WLC:Eccl.4.10": ["A", [32], "S103-TEV-MTF-019", "Eccl 4:10 if they fall one lifts his fellow; the companion who holds when the other slackens."],
"WLC:Eccl.4.11": ["A", [32], "S103-TEV-MTF-019", "Eccl 4:11 two lie together and are warm; cited as the continuation."],
"WLC:Eccl.4.12": ["A", [32], "S103-TEV-MTF-019", "Eccl 4:12 a threefold cord is not quickly broken; cited as the continuation."],
"WLC:Eccl.4.9": ["A", [2], "S103-TEV-SYD-001", "Eccl 4:9 two are better than one, with a good wage in their עָמָל; quoted after 4:8 where עמל and חסר stand together."],
"WLC:Eccl.9.10": ["R", [10], "", "Eccl 9:10 whatever your hand finds to do, do with might; no work in Sheol; uses מַעֲשֶׂה but adds no specific point to paragraph 10."],
"WLC:Exod.14.31": ["R", [4], "", "Exod 14:31 the people feared the LORD and believed in him and in Moses; faith after deliverance, but Isa 7:9 shows the trust/security wordplay the paragraph needs."],
"WLC:Exod.17.12": ["A", [7], "S103-TEV-SYD-003", "Exod 17:12 his hands were אֱמוּנָה until sunset, held up by Aaron and Hur; emunah as tested steadiness."],
"WLC:Exod.18.18": ["A", [24], "S103-TEV-MTF-014", "Exod 18:18 the thing is too heavy for you, you cannot do it alone; burden beyond capacity."],
"WLC:Exod.18.20": ["R", [23], "", "Exod 18:20 teach them the statutes (הַחֻקִּים); statute sense of חקק only; Bava Metzia 30b's reading of the same verse was also not used."],
"WLC:Exod.18.21": ["A", [24], "S103-TEV-MTF-014", "Exod 18:21 choose capable, truthful men; the sharing of the load, cited."],
"WLC:Exod.18.22": ["A", [24], "S103-TEV-MTF-014", "Exod 18:22 they will bear it with you; the shared burden quoted."],
"WLC:Exod.9.11": ["R", [30], "", "Exod 9:11 magicians cannot stand before Moses because of boils; the page's magicians are those of 7:126 who believed; no parallel to their patience."],
"WLC:Ezek.18.21": ["R", [1], "", "Ezek 18:21 the wicked who turns will live; repentance as exit from death, but the ayah's exception is not framed as turning; not used."],
"WLC:Ezek.18.24": ["R", [12], "", "Ezek 18:24 a righteous man's righteousness forgotten if he turns; loss of works by apostasy resembles 18:105 loosely; 1 Cor 3:15 chosen."],
"WLC:Ezek.3.17": ["R", [19], "", "Ezek 3:17 the watchman must warn; one-directional prophetic duty, not mutual counsel."],
"WLC:Ezek.3.18": ["R", [19], "", "Ezek 3:18 failure to warn brings bloodguilt; duty of warning, not reciprocity."],
"WLC:Ezek.3.19": ["R", [19], "", "Ezek 3:19 warning delivers one's own soul; not reciprocal; not used."],
"WLC:Ezra.6.14": ["R", [13], "", "Ezra 6:14 Aramaic וּמַצְלְחִין 'prospering' in building; צלח as success only; Jer 13:7 shows the sound/spoiled contrast relevant to salāḥ."],
"WLC:Ezra.7.10": ["R", [18], "", "Ezra 7:10 to study, to do and to teach Torah; learn-do-teach sequence, near transmission, but Avot 1:1 used."],
"WLC:Gen.15.6": ["A", [6], "S103-TEV-PRL-001", "Gen 15:6 וְהֶאֱמִן בַּיהוָה after 15:1 'fear not, I am your shield'; Abraham's faith and the removal of fear, compared with 6:81-82."],
"WLC:Gen.16.2": ["A", [29], "S103-TEV-SYD-010", "Gen 16:2 עֲצָרַנִי יְהוָה 'the LORD has restrained me from bearing'; עצר as holding back, cited."],
"WLC:Gen.18.19": ["A", [20], "S103-TEV-PRL-002", "Gen 18:19 that he may command (יְצַוֶּה) his children and household after him to keep the way of the LORD; parallel to 2:132."],
"WLC:Gen.31.40": ["R", [31], "", "Gen 31:40 Jacob consumed by heat by day and frost by night; resembles the hard winter cold of paragraph 31 but is a labour complaint; not used."],
"WLC:Gen.33.4": ["R", [38], "", "Gen 33:4 Esau runs and embraces Jacob; enemy-turned-brother scene close to 41:34, but the text gives no patience or repelling-with-good motive; not used."],
"WLC:Gen.37.31": ["A", [9], "S103-TEV-KRA-001", "Gen 37:31 the tunic dipped in goat's blood; the false evidence scene cited."],
"WLC:Gen.37.33": ["A", [9], "S103-TEV-KRA-001", "Gen 37:33 Jacob himself concludes 'an evil beast devoured him'; the opposite of 12:18's refusal."],
"WLC:Gen.41.49": ["A", [35], "S103-TEV-SYD-012", "Gen 41:49 Joseph heaped (וַיִּצְבֹּר) grain until he stopped counting; צבר 'heap' matches subra, not patience."],
"WLC:Gen.43.9": ["A", [32], "S103-TEV-MTF-018", "Gen 43:9 Judah: I will be surety for him; the guarantor image of paragraph 32."],
"WLC:Gen.44.33": ["A", [32], "S103-TEV-MTF-018", "Gen 44:33 Judah offers to remain a slave instead of the boy; surety paid, cited."],
"WLC:Gen.45.26": ["A", [9], "S103-TEV-KRA-001", "Gen 45:26 כִּי לֹא־הֶאֱמִין לָהֶם; Jacob disbelieves the true report, the inverse of 12:17-18."],
"WLC:Gen.45.27": ["A", [9], "S103-TEV-KRA-001", "Gen 45:27 seeing the wagons revives Jacob; context of 45:26, cited."],
"WLC:Gen.49.29": ["A", [20], "S103-TEV-KRA-002", "Gen 49:29 Jacob commands (וַיְצַו) his sons to bury him with his fathers; the content of the deathbed charge differs from 2:133."],
"WLC:Gen.50.25": ["R", [20], "", "Gen 50:25 Joseph binds the sons of Israel by oath about his bones; another burial charge; Gen 49 was used for the contrast."],
"WLC:Gen.6.9": ["R", [1], "", "Gen 6:9 Noah righteous in his generation; context of the flood, the exception wording is in 7:23 which was quoted."],
"WLC:Gen.7.23": ["A", [1], "S103-TEV-MTF-001", "Gen 7:23 only (אַךְ) Noah and those with him remained; exception from a universal destruction."],
"WLC:Hab.2.3": ["A", [36], "S103-TEV-MTF-020", "Hab 2:3 the vision will not lie; if it tarries, wait; patience grounded in a promise."],
"WLC:Hab.2.4": ["A", [36], "S103-TEV-MTF-020", "Hab 2:4 the righteous lives by his אֱמוּנָה; completes the waiting with the root of faith."],
"WLC:Hab.3.16": ["R", [29], "", "Hab 3:16 I wait quietly for the day of trouble; waiting motif, but Lam 3:26 was used for paragraph 29."],
"WLC:Hab.3.17": ["R", [14], "", "Hab 3:17 fig and vine fail; failed harvest, not the chaff/lasting contrast."],
"WLC:Hab.3.18": ["R", [28], "", "Hab 3:18 yet I will rejoice in the LORD; joy despite loss, not restraint; not used."],
"WLC:Hab.3.19": ["R", [33], "", "Hab 3:19 feet like hinds on heights; steady footing resembles 2:250 but adds no specific point."],
"WLC:Isa.1.17": ["R", [22], "", "Isa 1:17 learn to do good, seek justice; social justice, not reciprocal truth; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.26.3": ["R", [4], "", "Isa 26:3 'perfect peace, because he trusts (בָּטוּחַ) in you'; trust vocabulary is בטח, not אמן; the sol soydas claim for אמנ fails here (no אמנ form in the verse)."],
"WLC:Isa.26.4": ["R", [4], "", "Isa 26:4 trust (בטח) in the LORD, everlasting rock; root בטח, not אמן; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.28.16": ["R", [28], "", "Isa 28:16 הַמַּאֲמִין לֹא יָחִישׁ 'the one who believes will not hasten'; links faith with not hurrying (an endurance nuance), but the page's two אמן annotations (Isa 7:9, Exod 17:12) already carry the steadiness sense."],
"WLC:Isa.30.15": ["R", [29], "", "Isa 30:15 in quietness and trust (בִּטְחָה) your strength; root בטח; Lam 3:26 used for quiet waiting."],
"WLC:Isa.33.22": ["R", [23], "", "Isa 33:22 the LORD our lawgiver (מְחֹקְקֵנוּ); חקק in the decree sense; no due/portion sense."],
"WLC:Isa.40.31": ["R", [29], "", "Isa 40:31 those who wait (קוֹיֵ) renew strength; waiting motif with root קוה; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.42.3": ["R", [24], "", "Isa 42:3 a bruised reed he will not break; gentleness to the weak, not burden by capacity; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.42.4": ["R", [36], "", "Isa 42:4 he will not faint until he sets justice; endurance until justice, no promise-truth grounding; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.50.4": ["R", [18], "", "Isa 50:4 a tongue of the taught to sustain the weary with a word; the word sustaining others, close to counsel, but one-directional; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.51.7": ["R", [37], "", "Isa 51:7 do not fear the reproach of men; close to the cost of speaking truth, but Jer 20:8-9 is the first-person account."],
"WLC:Isa.55.10": ["R", [17], "", "Isa 55:10 rain waters the earth to give seed and bread; rain-to-growth image, but no joining of plants; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.55.11": ["R", [13], "", "Isa 55:11 my word will not return empty but will succeed (וְהִצְלִיחַ); צלח as success; Jer 13:7 was chosen for the salāḥ/fasād contrast."],
"WLC:Isa.58.11": ["R", [17], "", "Isa 58:11 a watered garden whose waters do not fail; continuous green image, but tied to the individual, not a joined community."],
"WLC:Isa.58.12": ["R", [15], "", "Isa 58:12 repairer of the breach; restoring what is cut resembles 2:27's reverse, but no specific addition."],
"WLC:Isa.58.6": ["R", [21], "", "Isa 58:6 the fast that loosens bonds; resembles 90:13 (freeing a neck) but the page's paragraph treats the reciprocal verb; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.58.7": ["R", [21], "", "Isa 58:7 share bread with the hungry; resembles 90:14 but not the mutual counsel; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.59.6": ["R", [12], "", "Isa 59:6 their webs will not become garments, their works are works of iniquity; futile works, close to 18:104, but Paul's 1 Cor 3:15 gives the loss wording; not used."],
"WLC:Isa.7.9": ["A", [4], "S103-TEV-SYD-002", "Isa 7:9 אִם לֹא תַאֲמִינוּ כִּי לֹא תֵאָמֵנוּ; hiphil/niphal wordplay linking belief and being established, against fear (7:2, 7:4)."],
"WLC:Jer.17.10": ["R", [27], "", "Jer 17:10 give each according to his ways; judgment by deeds duplicates Rom 2:6."],
"WLC:Jer.17.7": ["R", [4], "", "Jer 17:7 blessed is the man who trusts (יִבְטַח) in the LORD; root בטח, not אמן; not used."],
"WLC:Jer.17.8": ["R", [14], "", "Jer 17:8 tree by water not fearing heat; close to Ps 1:3, which was chosen because it uses צלח and the chaff contrast."],
"WLC:Jer.6.14": ["R", [22], "", "Jer 6:14 'peace, peace, when there is no peace'; false reassurance, an anti-ḥaqq image, but not used on this page."],
"WLC:Job.19.23": ["R", [22], "", "Job 19:23 that my words were inscribed (וְיֻחָקוּ) in a book; חקק as engraving; no truth/due sense; not used."],
"WLC:Job.2.10": ["R", [28], "", "Job 2:10 receive evil as well as good, without sinning with his lips; restraint of speech in adversity, close to paragraph 28, but Prov 16:32 was chosen for the self-mastery formula."],
"WLC:Job.27.16": ["R", [35], "", "Job 27:16 heaping up (יִצְבֹּר) silver like dust; צבר 'heap' as in Gen 41:49, but in a futility context; Gen 41:49's 'without number' fits subra better."],
"WLC:Job.8.14": ["R", [5], "", "Job 8:14 his trust (מִבְטַחוֹ) a spider's house; false refuge contrasted with me'men, but the root is בטח; not used."],
"WLC:Job.8.15": ["R", [5], "", "Job 8:15 leaning on his house it will not stand; context of 8:14; not used."],
"WLC:Josh.1.8": ["R", [13], "", "Josh 1:8 then you will make your way prosper (תַּצְלִיחַ); צלח as success; Ps 1:3 used for the same verb with the lasting-works image."],
"WLC:Lam.3.25": ["A", [29], "S103-TEV-MTF-017", "Lam 3:25 the LORD is good to those who wait for him; cited with 3:26."],
"WLC:Lam.3.26": ["A", [29], "S103-TEV-MTF-017", "Lam 3:26 good to wait in silence (דּוּמָם) for the LORD's salvation; waiting as restraint."],
"WLC:Lev.19.13": ["A", [11], "S103-TEV-MTF-005", "Lev 19:13 the hired worker's wage shall not remain with you until morning; cited with Deut 24:15."],
"WLC:Lev.19.17": ["R", [26], "", "Lev 19:17 reprove your neighbour and do not bear sin; reproof duty close to tavsiye, but one-directional and without ḥaqq/sabr; not used."],
"WLC:Lev.19.18": ["R", [19], "", "Lev 19:18 love your neighbour as yourself; reciprocity of love; not used."],
"WLC:Mal.3.16": ["A", [19], "S103-TEV-MTF-010", "Mal 3:16 נִדְבְּרוּ ... אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ those who feared the LORD spoke to one another; reciprocal verb quoted."],
"WLC:Mal.3.17": ["A", [19], "S103-TEV-MTF-010", "Mal 3:17 they shall be mine on the day I make; context of 3:16 cited."],
"WLC:Mal.3.18": ["A", [19], "S103-TEV-MTF-010", "Mal 3:18 you will distinguish the righteous from the wicked; the separated community cited."],
"WLC:Mic.6.8": ["R", [2], "", "Mic 6:8 do justice, love kindness, walk humbly; a short catalogue, represented on the page through Makkot 24a's chain which quotes it."],
"WLC:Num.11.17": ["R", [24], "", "Num 11:17 elders bear the burden with Moses; same shared-burden motif as Exod 18:18-22, which was quoted."],
"WLC:Prov.11.1": ["R", [23], "", "Prov 11:1 false balance an abomination; short weight, but Dan 5:27 gives the cognate root."],
"WLC:Prov.11.15": ["R", [32], "", "Prov 11:15 surety for a stranger brings harm; a warning against surety, the reverse of the kefil ideal; noted, not used."],
"WLC:Prov.11.24": ["R", [1], "", "Prov 11:24 withholding leads only to want (מַחְסוֹר); חסר as poverty; no specific addition to the exception paragraph."],
"WLC:Prov.14.5": ["R", [7], "", "Prov 14:5 a faithful witness (עֵד אֱמוּנִים) does not lie; trustworthiness, but Exod 17:12 was chosen for paragraph 7."],
"WLC:Prov.15.1": ["R", [38], "", "Prov 15:1 a soft answer turns away wrath; close to 41:34 but Prov 25:21 was chosen as the text Paul reads."],
"WLC:Prov.16.26": ["R", [10], "", "Prov 16:26 the labourer's appetite labours for him (נֶפֶשׁ עָמֵל עָמְלָה); עמל range already shown with Ecclesiastes."],
"WLC:Prov.16.32": ["A", [28], "S103-TEV-MTF-016", "Prov 16:32 better long of anger than mighty, ruling one's spirit than taking a city; self-restraint formula."],
"WLC:Prov.17.17": ["R", [32], "", "Prov 17:17 a brother born for adversity; companion in hardship, but Eccl 4:10 was used."],
"WLC:Prov.19.17": ["R", [35], "", "Prov 19:17 lending to the LORD who repays; reward motif without measureless heap; not used."],
"WLC:Prov.20.10": ["R", [23], "", "Prov 20:10 diverse weights and measures; short weight, covered by Dan 5:27."],
"WLC:Prov.24.12": ["R", [27], "", "Prov 24:12 he repays man according to his work; duplicates Rom 2:6."],
"WLC:Prov.25.14": ["R", [17], "", "Prov 25:14 clouds and wind without rain; empty promise, not the rain-cloud of paragraph 17's surah-level note."],
"WLC:Prov.25.15": ["R", [28], "", "Prov 25:15 by long patience (בְּאֹרֶךְ אַפַּיִם) a ruler is persuaded; same idiom as 16:32, which was quoted."],
"WLC:Prov.25.21": ["A", [38], "S103-TEV-MTF-023", "Prov 25:21 if your enemy hungers, give him bread; good returned for enmity."],
"WLC:Prov.25.22": ["A", [38], "S103-TEV-MTF-023", "Prov 25:22 coals heaped on his head and the LORD will repay you; the outcome compared with 41:34."],
"WLC:Prov.27.17": ["R", [19], "", "Prov 27:17 iron sharpens iron, man sharpens his fellow; reciprocal shaping, a good image but Mal 3:16/Avot 3:2 were chosen for the reciprocal verb."],
"WLC:Prov.27.5": ["R", [26], "", "Prov 27:5 open rebuke better than hidden love; reproof, not reciprocal; not used."],
"WLC:Prov.27.6": ["R", [31], "", "Prov 27:6 faithful (נֶאֱמָנִים) are the wounds of a friend; the bitter-but-healing and אמן link is apt, but paragraph 31's medicine image is served by Heb 12:11 and the page already has three אמן blocks."],
"WLC:Prov.27.9": ["R", [31], "", "Prov 27:9 oil and incense gladden, so a friend's counsel; sweet counsel, the opposite of bitter medicine; not used."],
"WLC:Prov.28.27": ["R", [1], "", "Prov 28:27 the giver to the poor will not lack (אֵין מַחְסוֹר); חסר as lack; no specific addition."],
"WLC:Prov.29.11": ["A", [28], "S103-TEV-MTF-016", "Prov 29:11 a fool vents all his spirit, the wise holds it back; cited beside 16:32."],
"WLC:Prov.3.23": ["R", [5], "", "Prov 3:23 walk your way securely (לָבֶטַח); security with root בטח; not used."],
"WLC:Prov.3.27": ["R", [23], "", "Prov 3:27 do not withhold good from its owners (מִבְּעָלָיו); close to ḥaqq as what is owed, but Lev 10:13 shows the cognate root; not used."],
"WLC:Prov.3.28": ["R", [23], "", "Prov 3:28 do not say 'come back tomorrow' when you have it; delayed due; not used."],
"WLC:Prov.3.3": ["R", [37], "", "Prov 3:3 let kindness and truth (אֱמֶת) not leave you; father-to-son counsel, but Tobit 4 and Jer 20 were used for paragraph 37."],
"WLC:Prov.31.21": ["R", [31], "", "Prov 31:21 her household does not fear snow; winter cold image only; weak."],
"WLC:Prov.8.29": ["R", [22], "", "Prov 8:29 when he set the sea its limit (חֻקּוֹ); ḥoq as boundary resembles 'fitting in its place' but adds no point beyond the due/portion annotation."],
"WLC:Ps.1.2": ["R", [16], "", "Ps 1:2 meditating day and night; continuity of day and night resembles 'joining night to day' but uses no joining verb; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.1.3": ["A", [14], "S103-TEV-MTF-007", "Ps 1:3 leaf does not wither and all he does prospers (יַצְלִיחַ); lasting works with a צלח verb."],
"WLC:Ps.1.4": ["A", [14], "S103-TEV-MTF-007", "Ps 1:4 like chaff the wind drives away; matches 18:45's wind-scattered stubble."],
"WLC:Ps.106.30": ["A", [29], "S103-TEV-SYD-010", "Ps 106:30 the plague was restrained (וַתֵּעָצַר); עצר quoted."],
"WLC:Ps.112.7": ["R", [4], "", "Ps 112:7 not afraid of evil tidings, heart firm trusting (בָּטֻחַ); fear and trust but root בטח; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.112.9": ["R", [14], "", "Ps 112:9 his righteousness endures forever; lasting righteousness of the generous, close to bâqiyât but Ps 1/Peah were chosen."],
"WLC:Ps.118.27": ["R", [29], "", "Ps 118:27 bind the festal offering with cords; binding image near masbūra (held for slaughter), but too remote."],
"WLC:Ps.119.160": ["A", [9], "S103-TEV-SYD-005", "Ps 119:160 the head of your word is אֱמֶת; emet from the root of faith, quoted."],
"WLC:Ps.119.30": ["R", [9], "", "Ps 119:30 I chose the way of אֱמוּנָה; faithfulness as a way, no added point to the emet annotation."],
"WLC:Ps.119.5": ["R", [23], "", "Ps 119:5 to keep your statutes (חֻקֶּיךָ); statute sense of חקק only."],
"WLC:Ps.119.86": ["R", [9], "", "Ps 119:86 all your commands are אֱמוּנָה; faithfulness of commands; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.119.90": ["R", [18], "", "Ps 119:90 your faithfulness to generation and generation; intergenerational אמונה, but of God, not of transmitters; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.125.1": ["R", [5], "", "Ps 125:1 those who trust (הַבֹּטְחִים) are like Mount Zion unmoved; root בטח; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.127.1": ["R", [12], "", "Ps 127:1 builders toil (עָמְלוּ) in vain without the LORD; vain work with עמל, close to 18:104, but 1 Cor 3:15 was chosen."],
"WLC:Ps.133.1": ["R", [17], "", "Ps 133:1 how good brothers dwelling together; unity motif without the pasture-joining image; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.133.3": ["R", [17], "", "Ps 133:3 dew of Hermon and commanded blessing; moisture image, not joined vegetation; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.141.3": ["R", [30], "", "Ps 141:3 a guard over my mouth, a watch at the door of my lips; a stopper image near the bottle-stopper of paragraph 30, but Prov 25:28 uses the cognate עצר; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.15.2": ["R", [22], "", "Ps 15:2 speaks truth in his heart; truth within, not exchanged; the psalm appears inside Makkot 24a's chain."],
"WLC:Ps.23.1": ["R", [17], "", "Ps 23:1 'I shall not lack (אֶחְסָר)' under the shepherd; חסר beside green pastures (23:2) is suggestive for paragraph 17, but the link is associative; noted, not used."],
"WLC:Ps.23.2": ["R", [17], "", "Ps 23:2 green pastures and still waters; pasture image of an individual led by God, not plants joining; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.27.13": ["R", [9], "", "Ps 27:13 had I not believed (הֶאֱמַנְתִּי) to see goodness; faith in hope; no added point."],
"WLC:Ps.27.14": ["R", [29], "", "Ps 27:14 wait for the LORD, be strong; waiting with root קוה; Lam 3:26 used."],
"WLC:Ps.33.4": ["R", [9], "", "Ps 33:4 all his work in אֱמוּנָה; faithfulness of God's work; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.37.3": ["R", [2], "", "Ps 37:3 trust in the LORD and do good; trust+deed pair (root בטח), dwell and feed on faithfulness; close to faith+work but not used."],
"WLC:Ps.37.7": ["R", [29], "", "Ps 37:7 be still and wait patiently, do not fret over the one who prospers (מַצְלִיחַ); waiting, already served by Lam 3:26."],
"WLC:Ps.39.7": ["R", [35], "", "Ps 39:7 (MT) he heaps up (יִצְבֹּר) and does not know who gathers; צבר in a futility context; Gen 41:49 chosen."],
"WLC:Ps.46.2": ["R", [5], "", "Ps 46:2 God our refuge (מַחֲסֶה) and strength; refuge with root חסה, not אמן; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.46.3": ["R", [4], "", "Ps 46:3 therefore we will not fear though the earth change; fearlessness, not the faith root; not used."],
"WLC:Ps.60.6": ["R", [24], "", "Ps 60:6 a banner (נֵס) for those who fear you, because of truth (קֹשֶׁט); banner and truth recall al-ḥaqīqa as banner, but the Hebrew truth word is קשט; noted, not used."],
"WLC:Ps.78.6": ["R", [18], "", "Ps 78:6 that the next generation might know and tell their children; transmission motif close to Avot 1:1; not used separately."],
"WLC:Ps.90.17": ["R", [10], "", "Ps 90:17 establish the work of our hands; enduring work, close to paragraph 10's trace, but no added point."],
"WLC:Zech.7.9": ["A", [21], "S103-TEV-MTF-011", "Zech 7:9 kindness and mercy (רַחֲמִים) each to his brother; reciprocal mercy compared with 90:17."],
"WLC:Zech.8.16": ["A", [22], "S103-TEV-MTF-012", "Zech 8:16 speak truth each with his neighbour; reciprocal truth quoted."],
"WLC:Zech.8.17": ["A", [22], "S103-TEV-MTF-012", "Zech 8:17 do not devise evil against a neighbour, love no false oath; context cited."],
"WLC:Zech.8.19": ["A", [22], "S103-TEV-MTF-012", "Zech 8:19 love truth and peace; cited as the chapter's close."]
},
"research": {
"CORPUSCORANICUM:103:1-3:kommentar": ["R", [1], "", "Corpus Coranicum cursory commentary on 103:1-3 (Robinson's market-evening reading, Neuwirth's liturgical hypothesis); no Jewish or Christian intertext for v.3; context only."],
"CORPUSCORANICUM:103:3:anmerkung": ["R", [21], "", "Corpus Coranicum note on 103:3 compares 90:17 and the verse division; no Bible intertext; context only."],
"CORPUSCORANICUM:103:literarkritik": ["R", [1], "", "Corpus Coranicum Literarkritik treats 103:3 as a later insertion (length, formula of late Meccan/Medinan texts; 90:17, 95:6, 84:25) against Cuypers' stylistic reading and Robinson's originality argument; important for paragraphs 1 and 3 but it is Qur'an-internal redaction criticism, outside the Tevrat/Incil layers; reported to the caller."],
"CORPUSCORANICUM:103:2:anmerkung": ["A", [23], "S103-TEV-SYD-009", "Corpus Coranicum note on 103:2 reports Torrey (1892): Peshitta Luke 9:24 renders ἀπόλλυμι with ḥsar, the root corresponding to Arabic ḫsr; cited as named scholarship for the cognate."],
"SEFARIA:Bava_Metzia.30b": ["R", [26], "", "Locator for the discovery item Bava Metzia 30b; judged there (beyond-the-letter reading of Exod 18:20); not used."],
"SEFARIA:Makkot.24a": ["A", [1], "S103-TEV-MTF-002", "Opened text of Makkot 24a; the reduction to Hab 2:4 quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.1": ["A", [18], "S103-TEV-MTF-009", "Opened text of Avot 1:1; quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.12": ["R", [13], "", "Opened Avot 1:12 (love and pursue peace); not used, see discovery verdict."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.14": ["R", [2], "", "Opened Avot 1:14 (if I am only for myself); not used, see discovery verdict."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.17": ["R", [10], "", "Opened Avot 1:17 (deed is the main thing); not used."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.2": ["R", [2], "", "Opened Avot 1:2 (three pillars); not used."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.1.6": ["R", [19], "", "Opened Avot 1:6 (acquire a companion); not used."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.2.15": ["A", [11], "S103-TEV-MTF-006", "Opened Avot 2:15; quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.2.16": ["A", [11], "S103-TEV-MTF-006", "Opened Avot 2:16; quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.3.2": ["A", [19], "S103-TEV-YGL-002", "Opened Avot 3:2, which quotes Mal 3:16; quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.4.16": ["R", [14], "", "Opened Avot 4:16 (vestibule); not used."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.4.2": ["A", [3], "S103-TEV-MTF-004", "Opened Avot 4:2; quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Pirkei_Avot.5.17": ["A", [26], "S103-TEV-MTF-015", "Opened Avot 5:17; quoted."],
"SEFARIA:Mishnah_Peah.1.1": ["A", [14], "S103-TEV-MTF-008", "Opened Peah 1:1; quoted."],
